name: @proworks-hub/financialreportingiq
description: FinancialReportingIQ — statements whose indirect cash flow refuses on each of its four breakers rather than plugging, a cash reconciliation invariant that is proven and never constructed (the FX line is a presented item, not a residual), balance-delta derivations labelled and barred from statutory runs, and ratios as a registry of versioned methods with no house default.
author: Steven Kreutzer
